title: The First Step towards Success
html:
Heylo,

Why do we sometimes put off that first step to success? Timing not right, it’s not perfect yet or some other excuse?

Successful people don’t wait for the perfect moment or aim for perfection because they could be waiting a very long time. Just getting on and starting something can take the pressure off.

If you just do it and don’t aim for perfection you will be off.

Just getting started is sometimes all you need to do to ensure your success as the momentum you build will keep you rolling.

Edmund Hillary climbed a huge mountain, never defeated by man before, by taking one step, then another, then another.....

Take one step at a time, complete it, then take another. I can only imagine the results you will achieve by doing this and I’m going to have great fun watching.

Kind regards,

Glenn Edley

Quote for the week

“The secret of getting ahead is getting started. The secret of getting started is breaking your complex overwhelming tasks into small manageable tasks, and then starting on the first one.”

– Mark Twain
